login.headline: Your itinerary, budget, and packing in one place.
login.blurb: Log spending as you go, so you know what's left before the last day.

landing.metaTitle: Kelana — plan it neatly, enjoy the journey

hero.badge: A trip planner made in Indonesia
hero.blurb: Itinerary, budget, spending, packing, even outfits. All in one trip, ready to open with friends — even when there's no signal.

rail.title: Everything a trip needs, in one place.
rail.days: Hour-by-hour activities, with duration and place
rail.budget: Multiple plan versions, money left per category
rail.expenses: Log on the go, works with no signal
rail.packing: Packing list, must-haves pinned until checked
rail.sharing: One link for friends — no sign-up

hari.title: Plan each day down to the hour
hari.body: Set the time, duration, place, and cost. Activities order themselves, and every cost drops straight into that day's budget.
hari.p2: A dedicated outfit for specific activities
hari.demoNote: These two lines already count toward the budget

anggaran.title: Compare before you commit
anggaran.body: Want a lean version or a comfier one? Make a few versions and see the difference. Each category's budget stays visible, so it's easy to tell what's still safe.

expenses.title: Spent something? Done in a tap
expenses.body: Log it once, the rest takes care of itself. By the time you're home, the summary is ready.

packing.title: No more forgotten-charger drama
packing.body: The packing list fills itself from the trip template. Must-haves stay pinned on top until you check them off one by one.

outfit.title: What to wear tomorrow? Sorted the night before
outfit.body: One set per day — top, bottom, down to footwear. So you're not digging through your bag at six in the morning.

sharing.title: One link, one group, no more back-and-forth
sharing.body: Share the plan with a link. Your friends just open it — no sign-up, no install.
sharing.m2sub: Opened from the link, no sign-up

inside.title: Take a look inside
inside.body: Real screens from the app: the daily plan, budget per category, and outfits per day.
inside.note1body: "Bring a spare shirt, the trail's waist-deep."
inside.note2sub: budget left on the last day — enough for souvenirs
inside.cap5: Outfit · per day or per activity
inside.cap6: Overview · the first thing you see
inside.note3body: 3 of 8 checked — 2 must-haves not in the bag yet

stories.title: 12,400 trips already planned on Kelana
stories.s1body: Everyone used to keep their own notes. Now we all see the same schedule and the same budget left.
stories.s2quote: "Logged spending while waiting for the boat"
stories.s2body: Works with no signal. By the time we got home the summary was tidy — no more collecting receipts.
stories.s3body: Beach and hiking trips need different bags. No more sandals left behind.

pricing.title: Start free, pay when you travel often
pricing.fineprint: Prices in rupiah, tax included. Cancel anytime — old trips stay readable.
pricing.freeNote: One active trip, no time limit.
pricing.plusNote: For those who travel every few months.

finalCta.title: Your next trip can start tonight
finalCta.body: Create a trip, set the dates, invite friends. The rest you can tidy up as you go.
